enonce.texte:
Read this short description of a film and answer the questions.

Film: 'The Lion King'
Plot: A young lion named Simba lives with his family in Africa. His uncle Scar kills his father and takes the kingdom. Simba runs away but later returns to fight Scar and become the king.
Main character: Simba is brave and kind. Scar is evil and greedy.

questions.texte: What is the name of the main character?
questions.reponse: Simba

questions.texte: Describe the character Scar in one word.
questions.reponse: Evil / Greedy

questions.texte: What happens to Simba's father?
questions.reponse: His uncle Scar kills his father.

questions.texte: Explain why Simba returns to fight Scar.
questions.reponse: Simba returns to fight Scar because he wants to become the king and take back his kingdom.

enonce.texte: You are at a party with friends in Douala. Complete the dialogue about entertainment preferences.

questions.texte:
A: 'What kind of music do you like?'
B: 'I ______ (like) listening to Bikutsi.'
questions.reponse: like

questions.texte:
A: 'Do you enjoy watching Nigerian films?'
B: 'Yes, I ______ (love) watching Nollywood movies.'
questions.reponse: love

questions.texte:
A: 'What genre do you prefer?'
B: 'I ______ (prefer) comedies because they are funny.'
questions.reponse: prefer

questions.texte:
A: 'What movie would you recommend?'
B: 'You should ______ (watch) 'The Wedding Party'. It's great!'
questions.reponse: watch

questions.texte:
A: 'Would you like to go to a concert next week?'
B: 'Yes, I would ______ (like) to see a live band!'
questions.reponse: like

enonce.texte: Your friend asks for recommendations for a good movie and a good song. Write your recommendations using the phrases below.

questions.texte: Recommend a movie and explain why you like it.
questions.reponse: I recommend 'Black Panther'. It is an action movie with a great story and amazing characters.

questions.texte: Recommend a song and explain why you like it.
questions.reponse: I recommend 'Calm Down' by Rema. It is a great song with a catchy melody.

questions.texte: Explain why you think your friend would like your recommendations.
questions.reponse: I think you would like 'Black Panther' because it has a lot of action. You would also like 'Calm Down' because it is very popular and easy to dance to.

enonce.texte: Write a short review of a film you have seen recently. Include the plot, main characters, your opinion, and a recommendation.

questions.texte: Write the plot of the film.
questions.reponse: Réponse personnelle (exemple: The film is about a young boy who discovers he has magical powers and must save his village.)

questions.texte: Describe the main character.
questions.reponse: Réponse personnelle (exemple: The main character is brave, kind, and determined.)

questions.texte: Give your opinion about the film.
questions.reponse: Réponse personnelle (exemple: In my opinion, the film is exciting and very well made.)

questions.texte: Recommend the film to someone.
questions.reponse: Réponse personnelle (exemple: I recommend this film to anyone who likes action and adventure.)

enonce.texte: You are planning to attend a concert in Douala. Write a dialogue between two friends discussing the concert.

questions.texte: Write a question asking about the concert.
questions.reponse: Are you going to the concert in Douala next week?

questions.texte: Write a response about who is performing.
questions.reponse: Yes, I am. It's a concert with some of the best Makossa artists.

questions.texte: Write a question about the type of music.
questions.reponse: What kind of music will they play?

questions.texte: Write a response expressing excitement.
questions.reponse: They will play Makossa and Bikutsi. I am so excited!

questions.texte: Write a question about the time.
questions.reponse: What time does the concert start?

enonce.texte:
Read these lyrics from a simple song and answer the questions.

Lyrics:
'I love the rain,
It washes away my pain.
I love the sun,
It makes me feel so young.'

questions.texte: What does the singer love?
questions.reponse: The singer loves the rain and the sun.

questions.texte: Why does the singer love the rain?
questions.reponse: The singer loves the rain because it washes away pain.

questions.texte: Why does the singer love the sun?
questions.reponse: The singer loves the sun because it makes him/her feel young.

questions.texte: Do you think these lyrics express positive or negative feelings? Why?
questions.reponse: The lyrics express positive feelings because the singer loves the rain and the sun and feels good.
